question: What form should be meditated upon after completing the bodily placement?
premises: The bodily placement has been performed as described.
The object of meditation is a bird whose nature is Śiva.
inference: After placing on the body in this way, one should meditate on a bird that is Śiva-natured.
plain_english: Having thus placed on the body, one should meditate on a bird whose nature is Śiva.
